project_overview.name: Lluna Blanca Blanes
project_overview.primary_goal: Contact via Phone or WhatsApp for reservations

theme: Light mode prioritized (Organic & Earthy). No forced dark mode to maintain the clean, spa-like purity.

headings.usage: Use tracking-tighter for large text. Never center align H1. Use for emotional resonance.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible. leading-relaxed. Use for descriptions, service cards, contact info.

accents.style: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs to text-sm, text-text_muted for overlines and small labels.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Asymmetrical. Use CSS Grid for Bento layouts in the gallery, but overlapping offset blocks for the Manifesto.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Delicate. 1px solid #E5E4DB. No heavy box-shadows. Opt for soft ambient shadow on hover only.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Wrap the entire application in `<ReactLenis root>` from @studio-freight/react-lenis for momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Kinetic Text Reveal: Split the H1 into lines. Wrap each line in an `overflow-hidden` div. Animate the text `y: '100%'` to `y: 0` with a slow ease-out (duration: 1s, stagger).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use Framer Motion's `useScroll` and `useTransform` to move hero images at a different speed than the document scroll.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Extremely slow speed, pale sage background with dark green text.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Image containers MUST have `overflow-hidden`. Images inside scale from `scale-100` to `scale-105` over 0.6s ease. Buttons lift `-translate-y-1`.

1_Hero.layout: Min-h-screen, asymmetrical split or overlapping floating image.
1_Hero.content: H1 Slogan ('Equilibrio, Relajación y Bienestar'), Llamar CTA (Primary Sage Button), WhatsApp CTA (Outline button with WhatsApp icon). Kinetic line-by-line reveal.
1_Hero.visuals: Large high-quality hero image with subtle parallax. Opacity overlay bg-black/10 maximum if needed for text contrast.

2_Marquee.content: · LLUNA BLANCA · BLANES · MASAJES · BIENESTAR · RELAJACIÓN ·
2_Marquee.style: font-serif italic text-2xl py-6 bg-background_secondary text-text_dark

3_Manifesto_About.layout: Numbered chapters. Staggered vertical flow. Large '01', '02' watermark-style numbers.
3_Manifesto_About.content: Brief presentation of Lluna Blanca, philosophy, and connection to Blanes.
3_Manifesto_About.visuals: Images clipped in elegant frames (e.g., aspect-[3/4] or arched borders) treated deliberately with subtle motion.

4_Services.layout: Modern bento cards or clean list with image hover reveals.
4_Services.content: Massage Name, Description, Duration, Price. Editable text.

5_Gallery.layout: Masonry or asymmetrical grid. Mix of landscape and portrait. `gap-4` or `gap-8`.

6_Testimonials.style: Large serif quote marks, italicized body text. Clean and trusting.

7_Contact.col_1: Contact info: Address in Blanes, Phone, WhatsApp button, Business Hours.
7_Contact.col_2: Google Maps iframe (apply CSS filter: grayscale(1) opacity(0.8) if possible to match aesthetic).

8_FAQ.style: Shadcn Accordion heavily customized. No background, just a bottom border. Elegant typography.

9_Footer.content: Massive 'Lluna Blanca' logo/text. Links: Legal, Privacy, Cookies, Socials. Elegant and spacious.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: IMPORT GOOGLE FONTS IN index.html: <link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Outfit:wght@300;400&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>
MANDATORY: Wrap the App content in React Lenis to achieve momentum scrolling. Do not skip this.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, accordion triggers, links).
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use the dark green #2C352B for deep contrast.
Do NOT center align text in sections unless specifically for short labels. Left align H2 and paragraphs for a premium editorial look.
Never use generic box-shadows. If required, use an ultra-soft shadow: `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]`
For the line-by-line reveal: Break text into individual words or lines inside a motion.div with hidden overflow, animating the inner span from translateY 100% to 0%.
Ensure the Google Maps iframe is responsive and embedded correctly.
Buttons should be pill-shaped. WhatsApp button should incorporate a distinct but elegant icon/color connection.
